**Test image analysis:**
- Opened soybean pod showing seeds covered with white/gray fluffy cottony mold growth
- Dark blackened discoloration on some seeds and pod walls
- White cottony mycelial growth filling the pod cavity

**Key matching features:**
- White Mold description specifically mentions "white cottony seeds in pods" — this is a direct match
- The white fluffy fungal growth inside the pod cavity is highly characteristic of Sclerotinia sclerotiorum (White Mold)
- The dark areas visible on pod walls are consistent with sclerotia formation

The reference image confirms White Mold shows white fluffy mycelium and black sclerotia on plant tissue. The test image shows identical white cottony mold growth enveloping the seeds inside the pod.
